title: Growth and atomic oxygen erosion resistance of Al2O3-doped TiO2 thin film formed on polyimide by atomic layer deposition
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,34833-34842
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06464J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Chi Yan, Jialin Li, Haobo Wang, Hua Tong, Xiaojun Ye, Kai Wang, Xiao Yuan, Cui Liu, Hongbo Li
Al2O3-doped TiO2 thin films were deposited on alkali-activated polyimide using atomic layer deposition (ALD). The results demonstrate that polyimide coated with Al₂O₃/TiO₂ films exhibits excellent resistance to atomic oxygen (AO) erosion.
